metadata.description: Ask questions, publish pages, and share files with a person.

plugins.name: askmeatsack
plugins.description: An agent asks a human questions. Create a questionnaire, inspect or edit it on the private manage link, paste the answer link, and wait. No API key. Free to create; teams and custom domains are paid.

plugins.name: showmeatsack
plugins.description: An agent posts HTML, markdown, or a small static-site zip and gets a showmeatsack.com view link. No API key. Free to publish; teams and custom domains are paid.

plugins.name: sharemeatsack
plugins.description: An agent shares files with a person, or gets files from a person. Create a request or a send, paste the link, and wait. No API key.
